name: bond strength
definition_zh: 钢筋与混凝土界面抵抗相对滑移或脱黏的能力。
usage_overview: 用于评价钢筋与混凝土界面的黏结承载能力。在拉拔试验中，以界面能够传递的峰值平均黏结应力表征，使抵抗相对滑移或脱黏的能力成为可测量的试验指标。

complete_examples.text: The results indicate that the bond strength of rebars will be reduced by the increase of the dosage of straw ash and will be intensive along with the decrease of the diameter of rebar.
In Table 4, the test results of bond strength and corresponding slip between rebars and straw ash concrete were presented.
